notes: ⏳ The report card now tells you how much of an edge to expect tomorrow. Every edge on the card is a measurement of the past — and the app has three years of its own history to say how well such measurements survive. A new ⏳ Expect decay line in the card header pools every line that earned a badge in an earlier stored year and reports what those same lines averaged in the year that followed: the typical haircut, stated plainly whichever way it falls (kept ~X% of themselves / held / did NOT survive), with the share that stayed positive. It computes live from the same three-year era study behind each line's ↘ fading and ↗ strengthening chips, hides itself honestly when the sample is too thin or the era windows don't match, and the full line-by-line breakdown stays one tap away in the ⚖ 'Does the grading work?' report. Nothing else moved: no grade, score, ladder rank or bot decision changes.
